purpose: Fail-closed operator checklist for promoting the optional ANPOS commercial service from certified staging to production sales.

recommended_publication_path.rule: The staged path is recommended while paid eligibility evidence is missing. An operator may choose another compliant path, but repository state cannot waive GitHub Marketplace requirements or authorize paid publication.

required_gates.rule: Create vendor-private anpos-commercial-service repository and populate it only from certified exporter output.
Create vendor-private anpos-commercial-template repository and populate it only from certified exporter output.

Create the customer-facing GitHub Marketplace App under the intended publisher organization. It must be public/installable by other accounts for Marketplace use, subscribe to required Marketplace events, and request only permissions justified by approved customer-facing capabilities.

Create a distinct private Vendor Distribution GitHub App under the vendor organization for private-template access. Do not use the customer-facing Marketplace App for vendor repository administration.

Verify Marketplace and Vendor GitHub App IDs are different, private keys are not reused, and production runtime uses GITHUB_MARKETPLACE_APP_* only for Marketplace reconciliation and GITHUB_VENDOR_APP_* only for vendor-template access.

Install only the Vendor Distribution App on the private commercial template with least privileges for enabled delivery modes. Archive-first requires Contents: read; Administration: write is allowed only for explicitly enabled collaborator provisioning.

Verify the Marketplace App is organization-owned; an organization owner controls/submits the listing; publisher verification prerequisites include verified organization domain, confirmed contact email and organization 2FA; complete financial onboarding for paid publication.

Before paid listing submission, verify the Marketplace GitHub App meets GitHub's current paid-listing installation threshold. The 2026-09-04 compliance baseline records a minimum of 100 installations; re-check official GitHub documentation before submission. A genuine free listing may be used first according to marketplace-staged-launch.json rather than fabricating threshold evidence.

Verify valid publisher contact information, relevant description, pricing plan, privacy URL, support URL/email, working relevant links, integration value beyond authentication, public/installable Marketplace App visibility, public availability rather than preview/invite-only, and Marketplace plan-change/cancellation webhook configuration.
Provide Marketplace-compliant logo, feature card and screenshots and verify GitHub branding/usage requirements before submission.

Configure actual Marketplace plan IDs/prices and map them to developer/pro/team/enterprise without repository-side invented billing values; for every paid plan verify monthly and annual USD pricing and an allowed Marketplace pricing model. A free-first route does not mutate these paid draft tiers automatically.
Verify the customer-facing product shows current plan/price, purchases and plan changes, cancellation/trial state, monthly-vs-annual billing cycle, and usage/remaining resources where applicable.

Verify either Marketplace free trials are disabled, or the current trial behavior is supported and private customer data from a cancelled trial is deleted within GitHub's required timeframe. The 2026-09-04 baseline records a 14-day trial and deletion within 30 days; re-check before publication.
Finalize Terms, Privacy, License/EULA, refund/cancellation, tax and support/SLA terms with appropriate legal/accounting review and ensure wording matches actual Marketplace billing/trial behavior.

Configure production DATABASE_URL, Marketplace App ID/private key and webhook secret, distinct Vendor App ID/private key and vendor installation/repo identifiers, Marketplace mapping, Ed25519 signing key, operator token, organization seat limits, and final issuer URL. Legacy GITHUB_APP_ID/GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY must not be used as substitutes.
Allow the Marketplace webhook endpoint through deployment protection while keeping operator/admin surfaces protected.

Verify /api/version returns the exact certified commercial service version, source ANPOS protocol version and split-github-app-v1 runtime contract. Production verification with --require-ready must include exact --expected-service-version and --expected-protocol-version values so a stale healthy artifact cannot pass.
Verify /api/ready returns HTTP 200 against production configuration, including split GitHub App credential checks and migration checksum, only after exact deployment identity has been confirmed.

Verify real purchased/changed/cancelled events plus duplicate/retry/hash-conflict behavior against production, and free-trial events when free trials are enabled. A free-only listing still requires real purchase/cancellation event evidence before publication.
Verify missed-event operator reconciliation and periodic Marketplace account/plan reconciliation against authenticated GitHub Marketplace state using the Marketplace App credential.
Verify entitled customer archive delivery from the vendor-private template using only the Vendor Distribution App credential.
Verify organization seat assign/revoke/capacity/principal-bound token refresh with a real organization.
Verify cancellation prevents future premium access without deleting, encrypting, remotely modifying or intentionally breaking generated customer repositories.
Verify production entitlement-ledger restore procedure and record current RPO/RTO evidence.
Deploy production from vendor-private source or a verified immutable artifact; do not rely on public canonical source access.

promotion_rule: Production sales are authorized only when every required paid-production gate has status=verified and evidence is recorded. Repository edits alone cannot set launch_authorized=true. Re-check blueprints/commercial/github-marketplace-compliance.json and the staged-launch strategy against official GitHub documentation immediately before Marketplace submission or paid conversion. Marketplace/Vendor GitHub App role separation and exact deployed artifact identity are mandatory for this reference architecture.
